finding.nextgen5000_lineage: B1a provenance binds to NEXTGEN5000 parent universe and an AUTO_REBUILD/shards lineage.

observed_shard_000.reason: The artifact was followed from PRE-shard provenance while checking whether a result-free holdout could be reconstructed.
observed_shard_000.safety_discovery: The artifact is not PRE-only: its records contain both pre and result fields, including finishing positions.
observed_shard_000.action_after_discovery: Stopped immediately; shards 001-004 were not opened in this investigation.

b1a_training_provenance.interpretation: The AUTO_REBUILD lineage is development/model-building evidence, not a scientifically clean final holdout source.

finding.holdout_decision: Do not use AUTO_REBUILD shards, including unopened shards 001-004, to manufacture or claim a final untouched 1000-race validation set.

forward_validation_route.preferred_route: Prospective pre-result capture on future racecards with model/rule freeze before results, followed by result join only after the capture cutoff.
